verdict.rationale: Bolna's dashboard Call History lets users view performance metrics, recordings, transcripts and raw execution data. The Analytics tab adds call summaries and extractions, so built-in call analytics exist without custom building. However, the evidence never specifically documents success-rate, duration, outcome or sentiment dashboards. missing for 10: explicit success-rate/outcome aggregation, duration charts, sentiment analysis in dashboards, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own

citations.quote: View performance metrics, listen to recordings, read transcripts, and access raw execution data for debugging and analysis.
